d: This video details the latest features added to Kite and Coin, alongside new Rainmatter investments and educational programs across the Zerodha ecosystem. On Kite, Terminal Mode now lets you save custom workspaces, trailing stop-loss automates trade management, and Screener runs stock filters directly on Kite web. Kite also alerts you with a portfolio-concentration warning if any single stock or sector exceeds fifty percent of your holdings. For savings, Coin now supports bank fixed deposits starting at one thousand rupees, daily microsavings from ten rupees using UPI AutoPay, and…
